notes.title: Letters and Documents
notes.content:
[b]LETTERA[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290265/fb31c4041dd5d304ca80dfd92bbffc2920a57efc.png[/img]  

[b]DOCUMENTO[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290265/5e2c8eaaa41ebdef8bc41d738004d0f768ea797d.png[/img]

These will be the animations and documents or letters that you will find lying around. As you can see, we are continuing to work with the small details as well. We implemented this feature to give players a deeper experience.
The purpose of these documents or letters is investigative, as well as simple historical or personal letters of the various characters in the game.

notes.title: Pick up Item
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290265/f0c76356162b9fb8fb0eeb7e35e1bdc3e908b4ff.png[/img]

The game continues its production and here I show you how the production is going.
A small spoiler that shows you how the animations will be when you pick up items around the map.
This work is done to make the experience deeper and actually helps you understand where the items are or are not.
